movers24h.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel allows for authentication bypass and account takeover in N-central. This vulnerability is the result of an incomplete patch for CVE-2026-18556.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Nx Console Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Nx Console contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that allowed a malicious version of Nx Console to be published. The compromised extension fetched an obfuscated payload that could harvested credentials from multiple sources on disk and in memory.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: TanStack Unspecified Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: TanStack contains an unspecified vulnerability that allowed malicious versions of the product to be published to the npm registry to publish credential-stealing malware under a trusted identity.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability via the ProxyServlet component.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SAP NetWeaver Deserialization Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer Metadata Uploader contains a deserialization vulnerability that allows a privileged attacker to compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the host system by deserializing untrusted or malicious content.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: tj-actions/changed-files GitHub Action Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: tj-actions/changed-files GitHub Action contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to discover secrets by reading Github Actions Workflow Logs. These secrets may include, but are not limited to, valid AWS access keys, GitHub personal access tokens (PATs), npm tokens, and private RSA keys.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: CyberoamOS (CROS) SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: CyberoamOS (CROS) contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the WebAdmin that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements remotely.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with administrative privileges to execute commands via the PRTG System Administrator web console.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Multiple Zyxel firewalls contain a path traversal vulnerability in the web management interface that could allow an attacker to download or upload files via a crafted URL.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: VMware vCenter Server Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: VMware vCenter Server contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol. This vulnerability could allow an attacker with network access to the vCenter Server to execute remote code by sending a specially crafted packet.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to read particular files in the /WEB-INF/web.xml endpoint.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Task Scheduler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Task Scheduler contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that can allow an attacker-provided, local application to escalate privileges outside of its AppContainer, and access privileged RPC functions.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) Insecure Default Password Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands remotely due to the use of default passwords.

movers24h.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco ASA and FTD Denial of Service Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain an infinite loop vulnerability that can lead to remote denial of service condition.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Laravel Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Laravel Framework contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability, allowing for remote command execution. This vulnerability may only be exploited if a malicious user has accessed the application encryption key (APP_KEY environment variable).

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Joomla! Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Joomla! contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows unauthorized access to webservice endpoints.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: ownCloud graphapi Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: ownCloud graphapi contains an information disclosure vulnerability that can reveal sensitive data stored in phpinfo() via GetPhpInfo.php, including administrative credentials.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Veeam Backup & Replication Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2 Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2 lacks proper validation of user-supplied data when parsing specific project files (improper input validation) resulting in an out-of-bounds write that allows for code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Open Type Font Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists when the Windows font library improperly handles specially crafted embedded fonts. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability could take control of the affected system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows TS WebProxy Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Directory traversal vulnerability in the TS WebProxy (TSWbPrxy) component in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to escalate privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS Webkit Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS WebKit contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via a crafted web site. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird Sandbox Escape Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a sandbox escape vulnerability that could result in remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a vulnerability in SAML which allows an attacker to bypass authentication.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco VPN Routers Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A vulnerability in the web interface of the Cisco VPN Routers could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code as root and gain full control of an affected system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Arcserve Unified Data Protection (UDP) Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Directory traversal vulnerability in Arcserve UDP allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information or cause a denial of service.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Race condition in mm/gup.c in the Linux kernel allows local users to escalate privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted OLE object.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Word Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Word contains a memory corruption vulnerability which when exploited could allow for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apache Solr DataImportHandler Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The optional Apache Solr module DataImportHandler contains a code injection vulnerability.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Accellion FTA SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Accellion FTA contains a SQL injection vulnerability exploited via a crafted host header in a request to document_root.html.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Integer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS CoreGraphics contain an integer overflow vulnerability which may allow code execution when processing a maliciously crafted PDF. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of FORCEDENTRY.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Citrix StoreFront Server XML External Entity (XXE) Processing Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Citrix StoreFront Server contains an XML External Entity (XXE) processing vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to retrieve potentially sensitive information.

movers24h.product: Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Citrix ADC, Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, and multiple Citrix SD-WAN WANOP appliance models contain an authorization bypass vulnerability that may allow unauthenticated access to certain URL endpoints. The attacker must have access to the NetScaler IP (NSIP) in order to perform exploitation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DIR-825 R1 Devices Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: D-Link DIR-825 R1 devices contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the web interface that may allow for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Adobe Font Manager Library Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Adobe Font Manager Library contains an unspecified vulnerability when handling specially crafted multi-master fonts (Adobe Type 1 PostScript format) that allows for remote code execution for all systems except Windows 10. For systems running Windows 10, an attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could execute code in an AppContainer sandbox context with limited privileges and capabilities.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Scripting Engine Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to how the Scripting Engine handles objects in memory, leading to remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Netgear JGS516PE Devices Missing Function Level Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Netgear JGS516PE devices contain a missing function level access control vulnerability.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Code Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a code injection vulnerability which in specific conditions could potentially enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Joomlack Page Builder Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Joomlack Page Builder contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via unauthenticated arbitrary file upload.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft DirectX NULL Byte Overwrite Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft DirectX contains a NULL byte overwrite vulnerability in the QuickTime Movie Parser Filter in quartz.dll in DirectShow which could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted QuickTime media file.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Defender Denial of Service Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Defender contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for denial of service.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) PHP Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a PHP remote file inclusion vulnerability that could allow for remote attackers to craft requests to the /h/rest endpoint to influence internal request dispatching, allowing inclusion of arbitrary files from the WebRoot directory.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Sudo Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Sudo contains an inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow local attacker to leverage sudo’s -R (--chroot) option to run arbitrary commands as root, even if they are not listed in the sudoers file.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Management Console (MMC) Improper Neutralization Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Management Console (MMC) contains an improper neutralization vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature locally.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC11 Router Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Tenda AC11 devices contain a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in /goform/setmac which allows attackers to execute code via a crafted post request.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Yealink Device Management Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Yealink Device Management contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central File Upload Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central contains a file upload vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: ThinkPHP "noneCms" Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: ThinkPHP "noneCms" contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution through crafted use of the filter parameter.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the widgetConfig[code] parameter in an ajax/render/widget_php routestring request.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity Cryptographic Weakness Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity have a cryptographic weakness in Telerik.Web.UI.dll that can be exploited to disclose encryption keys (Telerik.Web.UI.DialogParametersEncryptionKey and/or the MachineKey), perform cross-site-scripting (XSS) attacks, compromise the ASP.NET ViewState, and/or upload and download files.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Unraid Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Unraid contains a vulnerability due to the insecure use of the extract PHP function that can be abused to execute remote code as root. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5849 for initial access.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: WordPress File Manager Plugin Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: WordPress File Manager plugin contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute PHP code and upload malicious files on a target site.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote exploitation for credential access by an unauthenticated attacker.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Sophos SFOS SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Sophos Firewall operating system (SFOS) firmware contains a SQL injection vulnerability when configured with either the administration (HTTPS) service or the User Portal is exposed on the WAN zone. Successful exploitation may cause remote code execution to exfiltrate usernames and hashed passwords for the local device admin(s), portal admins, and user accounts used for remote access (but not external Active Directory or LDAP passwords).

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via crafted subWidgets data in an ajax/render/widget_tabbedcontainer_tab_panel request. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2019-16759.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMware vCenter Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: VMware vCenter Server contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir) when the Platform Services Controller (PSC) does not correctly implement access controls. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with network access to port 389 to extract sensitive information.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel Multiple Products Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Zyxel firewalls (ATP, USG, VM) and AP Controllers (NXC2500 and NXC5500) contain a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability in an undocumented account ("zyfwp") with an unchangeable password.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: ThinkPHP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: ThinkPHP contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via public//?s=index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]= followed by the command.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMware ESXi OpenSLP Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMware ESXi and Horizon DaaS OpenSLP Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: VMware ESXi and Horizon Desktop as a Service (DaaS) OpenSLP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to port 427 to overwrite the heap of the OpenSLP service to perform remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMware vCenter Server File Upload Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: VMware vCenter Server contains a file upload vulnerability in the Analytics service that allows a user with network access to port 443 to execute code.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMware vCenter Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: VMware vCenter Server vSphere Client contains a remote code execution vulnerability in a vCenter Server plugin which allows an attacker with network access to port 443 to execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMware vCenter Server Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: VMware vSphere Client contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Virtual SAN Health Check plug-in, which is enabled by default in vCenter Server, which allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting the REST API URLs which allow for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: TVT NVMS-1000 Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: TVT devices utilizing NVMS-1000 software contain a directory traversal vulnerability via GET /.. requests.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Unraid Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Unraid contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to gain access to the administrative interface. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5847 for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator Plugin File Download Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator plugin contains a file download vulnerability when an administrator creates a new copy of their site that allows an attacker to download the generated files from their Wordpress dashboard. This vulnerability affects Duplicator and Dulplicator Pro.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA100 SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to gain read-only access to unauthorized resources.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall Email Security Unrestricted Upload of File Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SonicWall Email Security contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to upload a file to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Social Warfare Plugin Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: WordPress Social Warfare plugin contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability affects Social Warfare and Social Warfare Pro.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) File Upload Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote users to upload files via login page customization.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Symantec Messaging Gateway Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Symantec Messaging Gateway contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution. With the ability to perform remote code execution, an attacker may also desire to perform privilege escalating actions.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Sumavision EMR Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR) contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing the creation of users with elevated privileges as administrator on a device.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall Email Security Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: SonicWall Email Security contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to read files on the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20022 to achieve privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan server contain a vulnerable EXE file that could allow a remote attacker to write data to a path on affected installations and bypass root login.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 devices contain a command injection vulnerability due to  the "formsetUsbUnload" function executes a dosystemCmd function with untrusted input. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted goform/setUsbUnload request.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Multiple VMware Products Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: VMware Workspace One Access, Access Connector, Identity Manager, and Identity Manager Connector contain a command injection vulnerability. An attacker with network access to the administrative configurator on port 8443 and a valid password for the configurator administrator account can execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan contain an unspecified vulnerability within a migration tool component that allows for remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro OfficeScan Directory Traversal Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Trend Micro OfficeScan contains a directory traversal vulnerability by extracting files from a zip file to a specific folder on the OfficeScan server, leading to remote code execution.

movers7d.product: Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to upload files.

movers7d.product: Apex One, OfficeScan and Worry-Free Business Security Agents
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Multiple Products Content Validation Escape Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security agents contain a content validation escape vulnerability that could allow an attacker to manipulate certain agent client components.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMware Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: VMware Fusion, Remote Console (VMRC) for Mac, and Horizon Client for Mac contain a privilege escalation vulnerability due to improper use of setuid binaries that allows attackers to escalate privileges to root.

movers7d.product: Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security on Microsoft Windows contain an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an attacker to manipulate a particular product folder to disable the security temporarily, abuse a specific Windows function, and attain privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: D-Link DSL-2760U Gateway Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the D-Link DSL-2760U gateway, allowing remote authenticated users to inject arbitrary web script or HTML.

movers7d.product: Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: TeamViewer Desktop Bypass Remote Login Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: TeamViewer Desktop allows for bypass of remote-login access control because the same AES key is used for different customers' installations. If an attacker were to know this key, they could decrypt protected information stored in registry or configuration files or decryption of the Unattended Access password to the system (which allows for remote login to the system).

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Polkit Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Red Hat Polkit contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability through the bypassing of credential checks for D-Bus requests, allowing for privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Jenkins User Interface (UI) Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Jenkins User Interface (UI) contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows users to see the names of jobs and builds otherwise inaccessible to them on the "Fingerprints" pages.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

newest.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

newest.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.

newest.product: Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchManager, and FortiSASE contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Out of Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains an out of bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

newest.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Sangoma Switchvox SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Sangoma Switchvox contains a SQL injection vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements against the backend PostgreSQL database using a single crafted request, including database operations and remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Kestra OSS OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

newest.vulnerabilityName: BerriAI LiteLLM Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to establish an authenticated MCP session using an arbitrary Bearer token.

newest.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands, resulting in remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ownCloud Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ownCloud contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to access, modify, or delete any file without authentication if the username of a victim is known, and the victim has no signing-key configured.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Unspecified Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that can allow for privilege escalation via IPv6 networking subsystem. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to Suse, Red Hat, and other products using Linux.

newest.vulnerabilityName: JFrog Artifactory Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory vulnerability. This can allow an authenticated user to write data outside the intended Docker cache path under specific remote-repository conditions.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ajax.NET Professional Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via arbitrary .NET classes. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft SQL Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code in the context of the SQL Server Database Engine service account.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds memory write vulnerability which could allow a local user to gain privileged access or cause a denial of service on the system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability which could lead to denial of service.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool (ABRT) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow local users with certain permissions to gain privileges via a symlink attack on a file with a predictable name. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Red Hat Libuser Race Condition Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Red Hat libuser contains a race condition vulnerability that allows authenticated local users to corrupt the /etc/passwd file to cause a denial of service or privilege escalation.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Gitea Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Gitea contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with repository write access to send a malicious patch to the diffpatch API endpoint to plant an executable Git hook and run shell commands as the Gitea service account.

newest.product: HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in
newest.vulnerabilityName: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in Improper Access Control Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in contain an improper access control vulnerability that can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data as well as unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in accessible data.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.

newest.vulnerabilityName: TrueConf Server Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: TrueConf Server contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized remote attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to use a specially crafted script to break out of the isolated environment and execute arbitrary code on the host system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: TrueConf Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: TrueConf Server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthorized attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to execute an arbitrary script.

newest.vulnerabilityName: MLflow Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: MLflow contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that can allow attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Double Free Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Weak Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a weak authentication vulnerability which allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apple macOS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apple macOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker on the network to authenticate to Screen Sharing without valid credentials.
